title: Checking HATECHECK: a cross-functional analysis of behaviour-aware learning for hate speech detection
benchmark_measurement: Detection of hate speech targeted at protected groups, including Muslims.
findings: The study evaluates generalization to held-out protected identity groups, which includes Muslims as a religious group. The findings indicate that models generalize more easily to held-out identity groups than to held-out functionalities. However, the paper does not present results broken down by the specific religious group, instead aggregating performance over all identity groups. The authors also note the limited religious coverage, pointing out that HATECHECK only includes Muslims and leaves out numerous other religious communities.
